name: Sangria
source:
Play as Inez, a vampire bouncer who woke up one night to find out her longtime companion, Heather, had left her. Or did she? When Inez starts to wonder what could’ve made Heather take off on her own, she questions some of their acquaintances from the bar, Sangria, about what each of them believes could have caused this. The owner, Jo, the drummer, Alec, the bartender, Loretta, and the private detective Bernard all have their own theories.

[From [url=https://verbenastudio.itch.io/sangria]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演伊内兹（Inez），一名吸血鬼保镖，一天晚上醒来，发现她的长期伴侣希瑟（Heather）离开了她。或者她是吗？当伊内兹开始想知道是什么让希瑟独自起飞时，她询问了他们在桑格利亚酒吧的一些熟人，他们每个人都认为是什么导致了这种情况。店主乔、鼓手亚历克、调酒师洛雷塔和私家侦探伯纳德都有自己的理论。

[来自[url=https://verbenastudio.itch.io/sangria]itch.io[/url]]
